name: Song Search
description: Search and filter downloaded songs with fuzzy matching, plus sortable filter buttons and Jukebox NONG support.

disable-mod.name: Disable Song Search
disable-mod.description: Turn the search dialog off entirely and restore the default song browser.

show-filters.name: Show filter buttons
show-filters.description: Show the sort/filter toggle buttons in the corner of the search dialog.

nong-symbols.name: Show NONG symbols
nong-symbols.description: Show a disc on songs that have a NONG set in Jukebox. Requires Jukebox to be installed; does nothing without it.

use-nong-metadata.name: Use NONG name and artist
use-nong-metadata.description: Display the NONG's name and artist in results when available instead of the original Newgrounds song.

issues.info: Report issues on the GitHub repository of the original mod, or in the Song Search thread.
